name: JP-BS-Bench split
key_rationale: Split by company, not by document: two filings of the same company (FY2025, FY2026) share layout and labels, so a document-level split would leak test layouts into dev.
rule: if edinetCode in forced_dev: 'dev'; else u = int(sha256(f'{salt}:{edinetCode}').hexdigest()[:8], 16) / 2**32; split = 'test' if u < test_fraction else 'dev'
policy: Development, debugging and threshold choices use dev documents only. The test set is evaluated once, with frozen code whose fingerprint is logged in bench/FREEZE_LOG.txt before the run.

amendments.change: forced-dev list: companies listed in bench/forced_dev.txt (the pilot filings, and any filing inspected before the test freeze) are always 'dev'. The hash rule is unchanged.
amendments.reason: Pilot filings are inspected while debugging; they must never become test documents.
